name: SuperRare
fix_description: In updateMerkleRoot(), the require condition uses (msg.sender != owner() || msg.sender != addr) which is always true (tautology). Fix: change to require(msg.sender == owner() || msg.sender == addr) so only authorized addresses can update the root.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct two-step exploit: unauthorized merkle root update followed by a claim using an empty proof. It matches an obvious missing access control pattern, requires little protocol-specific DeFi knowledge, and could be reproduced quickly by a competent auditor.
